title: Shoulder Shrugs - Bar
texts: Shoulder shrugs using a pull up bar

This workout is designed to increase strength in the muscles which control and stabilise your scapular. This is a great workout to do after a fingerboard session or before pull ups. 

Complete 5 sets of 5 reps of shoulder shrugs. Rest 90 seconds between each set. 
You can increase the load using additional weights in a rucksack or attached to a climbing harness. Only aim to reach a sub maximal intensity which is challenging but not close to failure. 

Focus on squeezing your abs and glutes throughout to maintain good form.
